name: ochakai
description: Your team's metric definitions, verified golden queries, and the interpretation knowledge around them.
long_description:
ochakai is a context provider for data agents. A semantic layer tells you that revenue = SUM(price); it does not tell you whether 100 is good or bad. ochakai keeps that missing half — metric definitions, verified golden queries, insights that say how to read a number, glossary terms, table catalog entries — curated by people and agents together.

This bundle is a client. It talks to an ochakai server over MCP: the public demo to look around, or your own deployment. No LLM runs inside ochakai, and it holds no warehouse credential — it hands back what people wrote and verified, with the provenance still on it.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: https://demo.ochak.ai reads a public demo knowledge base and writes nothing. Point this at your own deployment when you have one; against Cloud Run, sign in with `gcloud auth login` first and this bundle mints the ID token itself.

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Search the knowledge base; verified concepts rank higher.

tools.name: list_concepts
tools.description: Walk a review feed in full: stale verifications, drafts by usage, reported failures, passed expiries.

tools.name: get_concept
tools.description: One concept by id, with its body, attributes and links.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: One file of the bundle by path.

tools.name: put_concept
tools.description: Write a concept back. It lands as a draft for a human to rule on.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Say whether knowledge you acted on worked. This is what keeps the loop honest.
